reviews.comment: Finally authentic Bombay style Chinese in Hounslow! The Manchow soup with crispy noodles and Chicken Lollipop taste exactly like Mumbai roadside stalls.

reviews.author: Priya Sharma
reviews.comment: The Triple Combo is unreal! Generous portion of Schezwan rice and noodles with rich gravy. Will definitely be ordering weekly.

reviews.author: Rohan Mehta
reviews.comment: Bombay Chilli Dumplings and Masala Chips are top tier. Wok flavor is genuine, quick service and 100% Halal.

settings.name: INDO CHINESE
settings.description: Born on the vibrant, bustling streets of Bombay, Indo-Chinese cuisine is a true celebration of two rich culinary worlds coming together. Where traditional Chinese stir-fry and wok techniques meet bold Indian spices.

menu.description: Authentic dark soya broth infused with garlic, coriander, ginger, seasonal vegetables and topped with crispy fried noodles.
